principle: OMOS.OneGodian.com is the canonical operational, documentation, runtime, and tool node. OneGodian.com remains the private commerce layer, OneGodian.org remains the public identity/educational layer, app.OneGodian.com remains the application console surface, and QuantumOHI.com remains the advanced O-H-I/enterprise layer.

contentPillars.name: OMOS
contentPillars.role: Runtime, orchestration, persistence, audit, operating architecture, and customer decision workspace

contentPillars.name: Council
contentPillars.role: Independent model outputs, cross-model review, degraded-state handling, and governed synthesis

contentPillars.name: OLLM
contentPillars.role: OneGodian model/intelligence layer intended to participate through the provider-neutral Model Gateway

contentPillars.name: O-H-I
contentPillars.role: Comparison, critique, synthesis, supported dissent, and human-reviewed output discipline

contentPillars.name: Tools
contentPillars.role: Layer 1, Alignment, Identity, Verification, Intelligence, and runtime inspection tools

contentPillars.name: Developers
contentPillars.role: APIs, Model Gateway, Data/Action/Environment connection boundary, MCP roadmap, Engineering Council, and build evidence

contentPillars.name: Commerce
contentPillars.role: Outcome-based OMOS products and paid entitlement pathways; checkout authority remains external/server verified

contentPillars.name: Artifacts & Research
contentPillars.role: Source artifacts, standards, implementation evidence, visual material, and specialized OneGodian research

modelGateway.openaiSourceSupport: GPT-6 Astra connector contract exists on current source; live availability must be determined from deployed runtime evidence.
modelGateway.securityRule: Provider credentials remain server-side and capability authorization is explicit.

productionProof.rule: PASS only after all nine production evidence gates succeed, including durable PostgreSQL, Human Gate persistence, restart survival, and Dashboard History reopen.

pluginTargets.pluginUse: OMOS product cards, documentation links, runtime status, and verified entitlement handoff.

pluginTargets.role: Public identity, education, community, and institutional introduction
pluginTargets.pluginUse: OMOS explainers, public tools, framework summaries, and canonical links.

pluginTargets.role: Advanced O-H-I / enterprise governance and infrastructure
pluginTargets.pluginUse: Runtime, protocol, O-H-I, and technical capability blocks that link back to OMOS.

definitionOfDone: Route exists in the canonical content map and sitemap
Route is covered by regression/smoke tests
Route has public-safe copy and explicit maturity boundaries
Runtime-dependent claims can be checked through machine-readable evidence where possible
Deployment status is verified separately from repository merge state
